mistake: Letting your lower back arch off the floor.
name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and hips and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor.
Slowly extend the opposite arm and leg away from your body.
Return to the start and repeat on the other side.
tip: Exhale as you extend the arm and leg.

mistake: Holding your breath or letting your lower back arch.
name: Hollow Body Hold
steps: Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor into a banana shape.
Extend your arms by your ears or forward.
Hold the position and breathe steadily.
tip: Start with bent knees if your lower back lifts off the floor.

mistake: Letting your hips rock or your back arch.
name: Flutter Kicks
steps: Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Alternate small, quick kicks up and down.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
tip: Keep the kicks small and controlled.

mistake: Pulling on your neck or swinging up with momentum.
name: Toe Touches
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Reach your hands toward your toes.
Lift your shoulders off the floor as you reach.
Lower slowly back down.
tip: Lift with your abs, not your neck.

mistake: Swinging your legs to generate momentum.
name: Reverse Crunches
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent at 90 degrees.
Lift your hips off the floor toward your chest.
Lower your hips slowly without letting your feet drop.
Repeat with control.
tip: Use your lower abs to lift, not momentum.

mistake: Yanking your neck or using momentum to sit up.
name: Sit-Ups
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Sit up until your torso is upright.
Lower yourself back down slowly.
tip: Move slowly on the way down for more control.

mistake: Bending your knees to cheat the lift.
name: V-Ups
steps: Lie flat with arms overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms and legs together into a V shape.
Touch your hands to your feet at the top.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
tip: Keep your legs straight and move in one smooth motion.

mistake: Letting your hips bounce or sag.
name: Plank Jacks
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Jump both feet out wide.
Jump both feet back together.
Keep your hips level throughout.
tip: Keep your core braced and your hips still.
videoSource: Mixkit — Woman doing mountain climber exercise — https://mixkit.co/free-stock-video/woman-doing-mountain-climber-exercise-726/

mistake: Letting your hips rotate forward or backward.
name: Side Plank Hip Dips
steps: Lie on your side in a side plank on your forearm.
Stack your feet and lift your hips into a straight line.
Lower your hips toward the floor.
Lift your hips back up to the start.
tip: Keep your body in one straight line from head to feet.

mistake: Pulling your neck forward with your hands.
name: Cross-Body Crunches
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Lift one shoulder and bring that elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down with control.
Alternate sides.
tip: Rotate your torso, don't just lift the elbow.

mistake: Rocking side to side with your hips.
name: Heel Touches
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms by your sides.
Lift your shoulders slightly off the mat.
Reach one hand toward the same-side heel.
Alternate sides while keeping your shoulders lifted.
tip: Keep your shoulders off the mat for the whole set.

mistake: Moving only your arms instead of rotating your torso.
name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
steps: Sit with knees bent and feet lifted or on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands at your chest.
Lean back slightly with a straight back.
Rotate your torso side to side.
tip: Move from your waist and keep your chest up.

mistake: Throwing the weight forward for momentum.
name: Weighted Sit-Ups
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Sit up fully to an upright position.
Lower yourself back down slowly.
tip: Keep the weight close to your chest.

mistake: Letting your lower back arch off the floor.
name: Scissor Kicks
steps: Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs off the floor.
Cross them over and under each other in a scissor motion.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
tip: Keep your legs straight and low.

mistake: Dropping your legs too fast or lifting your shoulders.
name: Windshield Wipers
steps: Lie on your back with arms out in a T shape.
Lift your legs straight up to 90 degrees.
Lower both legs slowly to one side.
Return to centre and switch sides.
tip: Keep your shoulders on the floor throughout.

mistake: Swinging your body or using momentum to lift your knees.
name: Hanging Knee Raises
steps: Hang from a bar with arms straight and a firm grip.
Lift your knees toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
tip: Stop any swing before starting each rep.

mistake: Leaning forward instead of crunching sideways.
name: Standing Side Crunch
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee and crunch the same-side elbow toward it.
Return and repeat on the other side.
tip: Crunch from your obliques and keep your chest open.

mistake: Rounding your lower back or rushing the reps.
name: Seated Knee Tucks
steps: Sit on the edge of a chair and grip the sides with your hands.
Lean back slightly with a straight back.
Extend your legs out in front of you.
Tuck your knees back toward your chest.
tip: Keep your back straight as you lean back.

mistake: Letting your hips sway as you switch arms.
name: Plank Up-Downs
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower to a forearm plank one arm at a time.
Push back up to a high plank one arm at a time.
Alternate which arm leads each rep.
tip: Keep your hips level and don't rock side to side.
videoSource: Mixkit — Young man doing push-ups on the floor — https://mixkit.co/free-stock-video/young-man-doing-push-ups-on-the-floor-5048/

mistake: Letting your knees drift up or your back sag.
name: Bear Hold
steps: Start on hands and knees with hands under your shoulders.
Lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Hold the position and breathe steadily.
tip: Press the floor away and keep your spine neutral.
videoSource: Mixkit — Father and son doing push-ups together — https://mixkit.co/free-stock-video/father-and-son-doing-push-ups-together-4525/

mistake: Letting the band twist your torso.
name: Band Pallof Press
steps: Anchor a band at chest height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the band with both hands at your chest.
Press your arms straight out in front of you.
Resist the pull, hold briefly, then return.
tip: Brace your core like someone is about to push you.

mistake: Bending your knees or rushing the arc.
name: Lying Windmill
steps: Lie on your back with arms out in a T shape.
Lift your legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your legs to one side in a slow, controlled arc.
Return to centre and switch sides.
tip: Keep the opposite shoulder glued to the floor.

mistake: Rounding your back or holding your breath.
name: Boat Pose Hold
steps: Sit with knees bent and feet on the floor.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet off the floor.
Straighten your legs to form a V shape with your torso.
Reach your arms forward and hold.
tip: Lift your chest and keep your spine long.

mistake: Bending your knees or jerking up with momentum.
name: Jackknife Sit-Ups
steps: Lie flat with arms extended overhead.
Lift your legs and torso together.
Reach your hands toward your feet at the top.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
tip: Fold from your hips, not your neck.

mistake: Letting your hips rotate as your arm lifts.
name: Plank Reach
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Reach one arm straight forward.
Hold briefly without shifting your hips.
Switch arms and repeat.
tip: Brace hard and keep your hips square to the floor.

mistake: Pulling your neck or hunching forward.
name: Standing Knee-to-Elbow Crunch
steps: Stand tall with hands behind your head.
Lift your right knee and crunch your left elbow toward it.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides.
tip: Crunch your ribs toward your hip.
